title: Projektetage Catalogue Grid Fidelity
description: Bauteilkatalog tile grid looks different from the original bauteilbörse.png. Full catalogue figure must use the same stretch-to-frame rendering as split tiles, not object-fit cover on img.
summary: Fixed Bauteilkatalog grid not matching original bauteilbörse.png. Root cause: full catalogue used img object-fit cover (strong crop on wide image) while split tiles use per-cell background stretch. Added FigureEmbodiment.fit cover|fill; catalogue full figure uses crop 1×1 + fill; split tiles default to fill. Renderer and core tests pass.
